Create a polished full-color Korean action webtoon page, three stacked panels with narrow white gutters. Original adult characters, gritty rain-soaked rooftop martial-arts fight at night. Middle panel: dynamic close shot of deflected blade with sparks, large diagonal brush sound effect across center-left exactly "카앙!" in pale yellow, dark outline. At right jagged white shout balloon exactly "지금이야!"
Bottom panel: woman sweeping assailant's legs on wet rooftop, dramatic perspective. Large red angular sound effect at upper left exactly "콰직". At bottom right white dialogue balloon exactly two lines "끝난 줄 알았나?" and "아직 멀었어."
Make Korean lettering accurate and legible, slant the sound effects ~20 degrees, keep the dialogue horizontally typeset. Non-graphic action, no gore. Page should be a real comic scene, not a typography sheet.
